meta.preheader: NIFTY 50 fell 0.61% to 25,144.30 as realty, auto and metal indices led the declines; foreign investors bought ₹5,737 crore (provisional); the 10-year G-Sec yield rose to 7.31%.
meta.subject: Kubeerra Market Brief · Mon 16 Nov: NIFTY 50 ends 0.61% lower at 25,144.30; WPI and trade data due today

brief: The NIFTY 50 fell 0.61% to 25,144.30 and the Sensex 0.39% to 81,592.45 on Friday, ending a three-day run of gains; Nifty Bank lost 0.79% to 61,034.10, with realty, auto and metal indices down the most (Upstox News, Business Standard, Liquide).
Foreign investors bought a net ₹5,737 crore and domestic institutions sold ₹2,254 crore (provisional, Kotak Neo). The rupee closed 7 paise weaker at 94.19 per dollar (PTI).
The 10-year G-Sec yield rose to 7.31% from 7.25% after October retail inflation of 6.09% (Trading Economics). Brent settled 2 cents higher at $95.84 a barrel, its second weekly fall (Rigzone).

Overseas, the Nasdaq fell 0.91% and the S&P 500 0.40% as chipmakers declined, while the Dow rose 0.10%; the US 10-year yield was about 5.15% and the dollar index 103.38 (AP, Investopedia, Investrade).
India's October wholesale price and trade data are due today (Free Press Journal).

drivers.title: Inflation and the RBI
drivers.text: October retail inflation rose to 6.09% from 5.54%, above the RBI's 6% upper tolerance limit, with food inflation at 8.94% (PTI, Outlook Business). Radhika Rao of DBS Bank expects another rate rise in December, and ICRA's Aditi Nayar said a 25 basis point rise at the 2 to 4 December meeting appears almost certain (Outlook Business). Rate expectations reach bond yields, deposit rates and loan rates.

drivers.title: Wholesale prices
drivers.text: Wholesale price inflation was 11.39% in September, up from 9.92% in August, with fuel and power at 25.85% (DD India); the October figure is due today. Wholesale prices feed into companies' input costs and, with a lag, into consumer prices.

drivers.title: Crude oil
drivers.text: Brent settled at $95.84 on Friday after a second weekly fall. Bloomberg pointed to more Middle East supply and an International Energy Agency forecast of a surplus this quarter, against continued attacks on shipping in the Gulf region (Rigzone). India imports most of its crude, so oil prices reach the import bill, the rupee and fuel inflation.

drivers.title: Foreign flows
drivers.text: Exchange data show foreign investors bought a net ₹79,302 crore of Indian shares from 1 to 13 November (provisional, Kotak Neo). Geojit's VK Vijayakumar linked the buying to money moving away from AI-linked markets (IANS). Foreign buying adds demand for large-cap shares and for rupees.

global_cues.title: US yields and the Fed
global_cues.text: The US 10-year Treasury yield rose to about 5.15% on Friday (AP). CR Forex Advisors' Amit Pabari said markets were pricing an 85% chance of a Fed rate rise in December (PTI). Higher US yields and a firmer dollar reach India through the rupee and through foreign flows into emerging markets.

global_cues.title: US technology shares
global_cues.text: The Nasdaq fell 0.91% as chipmakers declined after Nvidia's chief executive resigned; Nvidia reports results on Tuesday (AP, Forbes, TradingKey). Global technology sentiment reaches Indian IT shares and foreign investors' allocation decisions.

global_cues.title: Asian markets
global_cues.text: On Friday Japan's Nikkei rose 0.53%, while Hong Kong's Hang Seng fell 1.55% and Korea's Kospi 0.98% (Edge Consultancy, AP). Moves in Asian markets shape the regional mood at India's open.

us.title: The session
us.text: Wall Street closed mixed: the Nasdaq fell 0.91% and the S&P 500 0.40%, while the Dow rose 0.10%. All three gained more than 2% over the week, their best week since early August (Investopedia, AP).

us.title: Chipmakers
us.text: Chip stocks led the declines after Nvidia's chief executive Jensen Huang resigned on Thursday. Nvidia closed about 2% lower ahead of Tuesday's results and AMD fell 8.8% (AP, Investopedia).

us.title: Rates and prices
us.text: October producer prices rose 0.3% on the month and 6.5% from a year earlier (Kitco). The 10-year Treasury yield rose to about 5.15% and the dollar index to 103.38, near its highest since April 2025 (Investrade, Investopedia).

events.title: Gulf shipping and the oil supply outlook
events.text: Brent ended almost flat as attacks on commercial shipping in the Gulf region continued, while an expected supply surplus this quarter and rising US stocks capped prices (Rigzone). The channel to India: crude prices and the import bill.

stories.headline: RBI gave Paytm's payments subsidiary in-principle approval to issue prepaid wallets
stories.what: On 13 Nov the RBI gave Paytm Payments Services, a wholly owned subsidiary of One 97 Communications, in-principle authorisation to run a prepaid payment instrument system, including wallets. It needs a final certificate, after a system audit, before it can start; the approval does not cover Paytm Payments Bank (Business Standard, Free Press Journal).
stories.why: It is a regulatory step for a listed fintech company and for competition in digital payments.

Among equity categories, large and mid cap funds took the most, ₹8,484 crore net, followed by small cap ₹6,407 crore, flexi cap ₹4,980 crore and mid cap ₹4,893 crore; ELSS funds had a net outflow of ₹578 crore.
Passive funds took a net ₹23,384 crore, including ₹12,974 crore into equity ETFs, ₹3,474 crore into gold ETFs and ₹3,091 crore into index funds; passive assets rose 0.6% to ₹14.79 lakh crore.

link.name: Kubeerra guide: What is a mutual fund?

category_explainer.text: Under SEBI's categorisation circular of 26 February 2026, an index fund or exchange traded fund (ETF) is an open-ended scheme that replicates or tracks a named index, and it must keep at least 95% of its total assets in the securities of that index. Because the portfolio follows the index, its value rises and falls with that index, so its risk depends largely on what the index holds: a broad market index spreads money across many companies, while a sector or thematic index concentrates it in a few. Each scheme's riskometer level is set out in the fund house's own documents.

learn.title: What the wholesale price index measures
paragraphs: India's wholesale price index (WPI) tracks the prices of goods traded in bulk, grouped as primary articles, fuel and power, and manufactured products (DD India). WPI inflation is the change in that index from a year earlier.
WPI inflation was 11.39% in September, up from 9.92% in August, and the fuel and power group was 25.85% higher than a year earlier (DD India). The October reading is due today (Free Press Journal).

Because wholesale prices feed into companies' input costs, a high WPI reading can pass into consumer prices with a lag, which is one reason it is watched alongside retail inflation, which was 6.09% in October (Outlook Business).
